denied_lock.instructions: Using controls.denied and definitions, is the modeled denied acquisition rejected without packet claim, descriptor, readiness-one write or lock28 release request?

late_retention.instructions: Using controls.claim-fault and controls.release-fault plus their injections, do the committed claims remain owned after the fault? This asks about retained ownership, not physical DMA containment.

late_exposure.instructions: Using controls.claim-fault and controls.release-fault and definitions, is native descriptor/readiness exposure denied for those late-fault callbacks?

snapshot.instructions: Does controls.head-changed show retention of the private claim while the externally changed head stays 37 rather than being silently repaired?

private_release.instructions: Do controls.lock-changed-after-grant, injections.lock_changed_after_grant, private_release_source and mutable_release_mutant support constant lock28 release identity despite the public lock field changing?

physical_scope.instructions: Does scope establish physical DMA ownership, drains and client acceptance for the complete W1700K NPU?
